tableDescription: Retail order line items from a Chinese superstore, capturing transactions with customer, product, geography, and financial details.

columnDescriptions.row_id: Unique sequential integer identifier for each order line item record.
columnDescriptions.order_id: Business key linking multiple line items to the same order.
columnDescriptions.order_date: Date the customer placed the order.
columnDescriptions.ship_date: Date the order was dispatched to the customer.
columnDescriptions.ship_mode: Shipping speed tier selected for delivery, e.g., standard or express.
columnDescriptions.customer_id: Unique business key identifying the purchasing customer.
columnDescriptions.customer_name: Full name of the purchasing customer.
columnDescriptions.segment: Market segment the customer belongs to, e.g., consumer or small business.
columnDescriptions.city: City of the delivery or customer address.
columnDescriptions.province: Province or autonomous region of the delivery address.
columnDescriptions.country_region: Country or region of the delivery address.
columnDescriptions.region: Broad geographic sales territory grouping multiple provinces.
columnDescriptions.product_id: Unique business key identifying the ordered product SKU.
columnDescriptions.category: Top-level product classification, e.g., office supplies or furniture.
columnDescriptions.sub_category: Secondary product classification within the top-level category.
columnDescriptions.product_name: Full descriptive name of the ordered product.
columnDescriptions.sales: Total revenue from the line item after discounts applied.
columnDescriptions.quantity: Number of product units included in the line item.
columnDescriptions.discount: Fractional discount rate applied to the line item price.
columnDescriptions.profit: Net profit on the line item after costs and discounts.
columnDescriptions.postal_code: Postal code of the delivery or customer address.
columnDescriptions.source_system: Name of the originating system that provided the data.
columnDescriptions.source_file: File path of the original source data file.
columnDescriptions.source_sheet: Worksheet name within the source file containing this data.
columnDescriptions.source_row_number: Row number in the source file for lineage traceability.
columnDescriptions.batch_id: Identifier for the ETL batch that loaded this record.
columnDescriptions.row_hash: SHA-256 hash of business fields used to detect row changes.
columnDescriptions.is_deleted: Soft-delete flag; 1 means logically deleted, 0 means active.
columnDescriptions.created_at: Timestamp when the record was first loaded into the database.
columnDescriptions.updated_at: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this record.

tableDescription: Maps each geographic sales region in China to its assigned regional manager, sourced from the Tableau Superstore sample dataset.

columnDescriptions.region: Name of the geographic sales region within China.
columnDescriptions.regional_manager: Full name of the manager responsible for the sales region.
columnDescriptions.source_system: Identifier of the upstream system that provided this data.
columnDescriptions.source_file: Repository file path of the originating spreadsheet.
columnDescriptions.source_sheet: Worksheet tab name within the source file containing this record.
columnDescriptions.source_row_number: Row position of this record in the original source file.
columnDescriptions.batch_id: Unique identifier for the ETL import batch that loaded this record.
columnDescriptions.row_hash: SHA-256 fingerprint of business fields used to detect row changes.
columnDescriptions.is_deleted: Soft-delete flag; 1 means the record is logically removed.
columnDescriptions.created_at: Timestamp when the record was first inserted into this table.
columnDescriptions.updated_at: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this record.

tableDescription: Tracks orders flagged as returned from the Tableau Superstore dataset, with full ETL lineage and soft-delete support.

columnDescriptions.id: Surrogate primary key uniquely identifying each return record.
columnDescriptions.order_id: Business key linking this return entry to a specific customer order.
columnDescriptions.returned: Indicates the order was returned; expected value is 是 (Yes).
columnDescriptions.source_system: Name of the upstream system from which this record was ingested.
columnDescriptions.source_file: Full file path of the Excel workbook supplying the source data.
columnDescriptions.source_sheet: Worksheet tab within the source file where this row originated.
columnDescriptions.source_row_number: Row position in the source file mapped to this record.
columnDescriptions.batch_id: Groups all records loaded together in the same import execution.
columnDescriptions.row_hash: SHA-256 hash of business fields for deduplication and change detection.
columnDescriptions.is_deleted: Soft-delete flag; value 1 means the record is logically removed.
columnDescriptions.created_at: Timestamp when this record was first inserted into the database.
columnDescriptions.updated_at: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this record.
